weeks.notes_en: Scheduled run on 28 Sep. GSC clicks 3 to 7, impressions 184 to 177; average position 17.2 to 12.8 driven mainly by /login and branded queries, not non-brand rankings. GA4 186 sessions and the first 3 generate_lead key events (2 users, all Direct, unverified). GA4 Organic Search 37 to 16, opposite to GSC. AI citations 18 to 12. weeks.notes_en: Backfilled on 21 Sep. The whole melbourne query cluster went to zero impressions, replaced by Sydney/Brisbane/Adelaide and national variants — which is why average position jumped 30.7 to 17.2 while impressions and clicks both fell. Direct rose 37 to 63 sessions at 2 seconds each and needs a bot check. No AI sessions at all. Ahrefs and AI citations come from the 18 Sep snapshot.

weeks.notes_en: GSC lags 3 days; latest data 4 Sep. The 404 incident is resolved: all 16 article URLs return HTTP 200 again. Most of this week's movement is fallout from Google re-indexing those pages. stage.dxliving.com is still unfixed.
